newsitem.title: USA: Alrenco closes acquisitions, sets others.
newsitem.headline: Alrenco closes acquisitions, sets others.

text.p: Alrenco Inc, which operates rent-to-own stores in the Southeast, Mid-Atlantic and Midwest states, said Wednesday it completed acquisition of eight stores and signed a letter of intent to acquire four additional stores.
Terms of the completed and proposed transactions were not disclosed.
Of the acquisitions completed Wednesday, five are located in Kentucky, two in Kansas City and one is in Atlanta.
The letter of intent covers four stores in Dallas. This deal is expected to close by the end of the month.
Alrenco has acquired a total of 67 stores since the beginning of the year, almost doubling its size.
Alrenco operates 127 stores in 17 states, offering brand-name consumer merchandise under rental-purchase agreements, also known as rent-to-own agreements.
Earlier Wednesday, the company reported 1996 third quarter earnings rose 313 percent from a year ago to $1.1 million or $0.24 a share. Revenues for the third quarter rose 84 percent $17.2 million.
